title: Canonical upper pullback comparison on an iterated fiber product
statement: Let X,Y,S,T be schemes [def-pc-scheme] with a family of derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], f:X→Y, g:S→Y and h:T→S. Let k:(X×Y S)×S T→X×Y T satisfy k followed by the outer first projection equals the composite inner first projections, and k followed by the outer second projection equals the inner second projection [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let U be quasi-coherent derived pullback along the outer first projection, L along k, and V the composite along the two inner first projections [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Then L is an equivalence and there exists a natural isomorphism s:U⋙L≅V whose image under the full-subcategory inclusion is the pinned composition comparison for k and the outer first projection, followed by the equality transport for the first projection equation, followed by the inverse pinned composition comparison for the inner first projections [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. No compactness or invertibility of base change is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0D5S, cohomology-lemma-derived-pullback-composition; restriction to the full QCoh subcategory and the iterated pullback universal property

proof.text: Restrict the pinned composition and identity comparisons through the fully faithful QCoh inclusion to give cc and ii.

By pullback.hom_ext and the projection equations, k is pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso.hom. Compose cc with inverse-identity equality transports and ii, and apply Equivalence.mk to qcPullback k with inverse pullback along the inverse scheme isomorphism.
Compose the two ambient pullback comparisons around the first-projection equality transport. Lift via the fully faithful inclusion and evaluate map_preimage to compute the prescribed component.

theorem rectangle_ordinary_geometric_pullback
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y S T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : S ⟶ Y) (h : T ⟶ S)
    (k : pullback (pullback.snd f g) h ⟶ pullback f (h ≫ g))
    (hk₁ : k ≫ pullback.fst f (h ≫ g) =
      pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h ≫ pullback.fst f g)
    (hk₂ : k ≫ pullback.snd f (h ≫ g) = pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h) :
    let U := qcPullback (pullback.fst f (h ≫ g))
    let L := qcPullback k
    let V := qcPullback (pullback.fst f g) ⋙
      qcPullback (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h)
    ∃ (s : U ⋙ L ≅ V),
      L.IsEquivalence ∧
      (∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
        (schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback (pullback.snd f g) h)).ι.map
            (s.hom.app E) =
          (let comp := @Classical.choose _ _ (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
            (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)))
           (comp k (pullback.fst f (h ≫ g))).hom.app E.obj ≫
             eqToHom (congrArg (fun v ↦ (derivedPullback v).obj E.obj) hk₁) ≫
             (comp (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h)
               (pullback.fst f g)).inv.app E.obj))
